scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare is used because recompute from raw DFT artifacts inside the checker is infeasible; structural audit for edge states and strain trends complements numeric comparisons.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for cleavage energy/strength, SOC gap, Z2 invariant, and strain trend expectations.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Fig. 2(b) for cleavage, text for SOC gap (50.7 meV), Fig. 5 for Z2=1, Fig. 7 for strain trend description.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers and qualitative descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published results; any correct reproduction with reasonable toolchain variation should lie within the specified tolerances.

outputs.description: Cleavage energy and strength for exfoliation feasibility.
SOC‑induced band gap at the Dirac point (PBE value).
Nanoribbon band structure showing helical edge states.
Band gap evolution under uniaxial strain along x and y directions.

output_contract.notes: Phonon spectrum omitted as per approved plan; HSE band gap is optional; scoring uses PBE gap only. Edge states are checked for Dirac‑like crossing inside the gap; strain trend checks monotonic/ordering of gap under strain.
